data.narrative:
Portal Biotech is a Series A biotech company founded by Andy Heron and Giovanni Maglia that has raised $35M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a broader Biotech & Health sector universe comprising 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Abridge, Chai Discovery, New Limit, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Given data constraints, only the stage-progression method proved applicable. Using Portal's $35M in total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A to subsequent-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $70M. The peer-median approach could not be applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum thresholds (fewer than 3 datapoints in narrow peer cohorts). Public-comp anchoring using the Biotech & Health sector P/S median of 6.6x across three public tickers was not feasible absent Portal's revenue figures, which private companies rarely disclose.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $60M to $80M, with $70M as the median estimate. This range reflects moderate confidence based on a single triangulation method. Key uncertainties include Portal's undisclosed revenue trajectory, burn rate, clinical/pipeline stage maturity, and intellectual property strength relative to the identified peer set. A revised valuation should incorporate disclosed revenue or a more granular stage-within-stage positioning once available.
